title: Capture-to-FSM protocol extraction with timing watermark check

steps.action: Ingest the capture and pair requests with responses using the explicit pairing state machine; only request-to-response pairs may form causal edges
Extract the protocol state machine and per-message facts with provenance
Run the timing watermark detector over the inter-arrival time series before trusting the capture as clean input
Treat any watermark finding as adversarial evidence: quarantine the affected window and report, never silently proceed

decision_hooks.criteria: The dispatched task analyzes captured network traffic or reverse-engineers a wire protocol
